I have a PRD for my roguelike dungeon crawler (attached below). Please generate the full SDD with ordered development tasks organized into sprints.

--- PRD FOLLOWS ---

# DungeonDelve — Product Requirements Document

## 1. Game Overview
### 1.1 Elevator Pitch
DungeonDelve is a turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler where players descend ever-deeper procedurally-generated dungeons, choosing from three unique character classes and collecting powerful items, facing a boss every 5 floors, with permadeath driving tension and meta-progression providing long-term goals.

### 1.2 Genre & References
- Primary: Roguelike dungeon crawler
- References: Hades (meta-progression feel), Slay the Spire (turn-based clarity), Pixel Dungeon (visual style)

### 1.3 Target Platform
- PC (Windows primary), WebGL secondary
- Minimum: integrated graphics, 4GB RAM
- Target: 1920x1080, 16:9

### 1.4 Art Style
- 16-bit pixel art, 32px PPU
- Dark dungeon palette: deep blues, greens, warm torch glow
- UI: clean and minimal, dark panels with gold/white text

## 2. Core Mechanics
### 2.1 Core Loop
Enter dungeon → Move turn-by-turn on grid → Find items/gold → Fight enemies → Defeat boss → Descend deeper → Die → Unlock meta-progression → Start again

### 2.2 Player Classes
- Warrior: High HP, melee attacks, block mechanic
- Rogue: Low HP, high damage, dodge/stealth mechanics
- Mage: Lowest HP, ranged spells with mana system

### 2.3 Combat System
- Grid-based, turn-based
- Player acts, then all enemies act
- Stats: HP, Attack, Defense, Speed (determines action order)
- Enemies have simple AI: patrol → chase → attack

### 2.4 Progression
- Items: weapons, armor, rings, potions (found in rooms or dropped by enemies)
- Meta: unlock new starting items, class variants, dungeon modifiers between runs

## 3. Unity Technical Architecture
### 3.1 Project Structure
Assets/Scripts/Core, Player, Enemies, Systems, UI, Utilities; ScriptableObjects/, Prefabs/, Scenes/, Art/, Audio/

### 3.2 Scenes
- Bootstrap: managers + DontDestroyOnLoad setup → loads MainMenu
- MainMenu: class select, meta-progression display
- Gameplay: the dungeon (single scene, floor changes via room regeneration)

### 3.3 Key MonoBehaviours
- GameManager: game state, run state, floor tracking
- TurnManager: turn order queue, action resolution
- DungeonGenerator: procedural room/corridor generation on new floor
- PlayerController: receives input, queues player action to TurnManager
- EntityStats: HP, attack, defense for both player and enemies
- EnemyAI: simple patrol/chase/attack state machine
- InventorySystem: holds items, equip/unequip logic
- ItemPickup: world item that can be collected

### 3.4 ScriptableObjects
- ClassDefinition: starting stats, starting items, class ability definition
- ItemData: item name, stats, type (weapon/armor/ring/consumable), sprite
- EnemyConfig: stats, AI behavior parameters, loot table
- MetaUnlock: unlock condition, unlock reward definition

## 4. Milestones
### 4.1 MVP
- One class (Warrior), procedural dungeon, basic combat, enemy AI, item pickup, permadeath, win condition (reach floor 10)
### 4.2 Phases
- Prototype: movement + combat loop playable
- Alpha: all 3 classes, full item set, boss fights
- Beta: meta-progression, polish, audio
- Release: WebGL build, itch.io launch

## 5. SDD Handoff
### 5.1 Feature Breakdown
#### Feature: Grid Movement
- Description: Player moves one tile per turn on a tile grid
- Inputs: WASD/arrow key press
- Outputs: Player position updated, turn consumed
- Dependencies: TurnManager, DungeonGenerator (knows walkable tiles)
- Acceptance: Player moves exactly 1 tile per input; walls block movement; moving triggers turn resolution
- Priority: MVP

#### Feature: Turn Resolution
- Description: After player acts, all enemies take their action in speed order
- Inputs: PlayerAction queued to TurnManager
- Outputs: All entity actions resolved, board state updated
- Dependencies: TurnManager, EnemyAI, EntityStats
- Acceptance: Enemy acts after every player action; faster enemies act before slower ones; dead entities removed from queue
- Priority: MVP

#### Feature: Combat
- Description: Player and enemies deal damage based on Attack minus Defense
- Inputs: Attack action targeting adjacent entity
- Outputs: Damage applied to target EntityStats; death triggered if HP <= 0
- Dependencies: EntityStats
- Acceptance: Damage = max(1, Attacker.Attack - Defender.Defense); OnDeath fires correctly; HP never goes below 0
- Priority: MVP

### 5.2 System Contracts
#### System: TurnManager
```csharp
public void RegisterEntity(IActable entity);
public void UnregisterEntity(IActable entity);
public void SubmitPlayerAction(IAction action);
public event Action OnTurnResolutionStart;
public event Action OnTurnResolutionEnd;
public bool IsPlayerTurn { get; }
```

#### System: EntityStats
```csharp
public void TakeDamage(int amount);
public void Heal(int amount);
public event Action<int, int> OnHealthChanged; // current, max
public event Action OnDeath;
public int CurrentHP { get; }
public int MaxHP { get; }
public int Attack { get; }
public int Defense { get; }
```

#### System: DungeonGenerator
```csharp
public void GenerateFloor(int floorNumber);
public bool IsTileWalkable(Vector2Int position);
public Vector2Int GetPlayerSpawnPosition();
public List<Vector2Int> GetEnemySpawnPositions();
public event Action OnFloorGenerated;
```
